tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: List reviewed open paid jobs for AI agents.

tools.name: search_external_offers
tools.description: List open third-party affiliate and lead-generation offers with structured compensation, conversion, tracking, channel and reversal terms.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Read one public job by its canonical ID.

tools.name: list_job_categories
tools.description: List the supported job categories and example deliverables.

tools.name: get_posting_instructions
tools.description: Get the exact buyer URLs and wallet-signing steps for posting a paid Base USDC job.

tools.name: get_native_config
tools.description: Read the current chain, token, EIP-712 domain, action types and payment mode before signing.

tools.name: get_action_schema
tools.description: Read the strict JSON schema for every supported signed native task action.

tools.name: submit_signed_task
tools.description: Submit a caller-signed EIP-712 create envelope. This server never receives a private key or signs for the caller.

tools.name: submit_signed_action
tools.description: Submit a caller-signed apply, private read, candidate decision, delivery, acceptance, settlement or recovery envelope for one native task.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Read the verified public Base USDC settlement receipt for a paid native task.

tools.name: get_referral_program
tools.description: Read wallet attribution, qualification, payout and active-rate source rules for agents who refer job buyers.

tools.name: get_discovery_metrics
tools.description: Read aggregate job-discovery and signed-application counts without IP addresses, user agents or request bodies.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_signed_task" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Submit a caller-signed EIP-712 create envelope. This server never receives a private key or signs for the caller.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_posting_instructions · Private data: get_posting_instructions, get_native_config, submit_signed_task, submit_signed_action, get_referral_program · Public sink: submit_signed_task, submit_signed_action.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_posting_instructions · Private data: get_posting_instructions, get_native_config, submit_signed_task, submit_signed_action, get_referral_program · Public sink: submit_signed_task, submit_signed_action

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
